name: go-compose
shape: Go mailing-list server with in-process campaign workers, timers and uploads on disk; Postgres

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: a Dockerfile and a docker-compose.yml for self-hosting; no platform file

processes.what: Go server (Echo) with the admin UI
processes.note: docker-entrypoint.sh ./listmonk; one process serves the API, the admin, the public pages and runs the background loops

data.note: postgres:17 in the compose file; the app speaks to it through sqlx/pq
the filesystem media provider writes uploads under uploads/ (the S3 provider is the other option)

breaks.note: robfig/cron for the bounce mailbox scan and other periodic jobs
a ticker that checks for new versions
the cleaner of expired one-time tokens
goroutines that scan campaigns and send messages
password reset and 2FA tokens in a package-level map behind a mutex

idle.note: server-sent events stream for the admin

notes: Read: cmd/init.go, cmd/updates.go, cmd/events.go, internal/manager/manager.go, internal/bounce/bounce.go, internal/media/providers/filesystem/filesystem.go, internal/tmptokens/tmptokens.go, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml. A ticker named for a push timeout and the install step's config write are not findings (v0.2.5).
